blocks.text: Ko'p sifatlardan keyin **to + fe'l** keladi. Eng oddiy qolip qizil kitobdan tanish: **It's easy to** learn (→ qizil kitob, 39-dars). Bu darsda sifat + to ning to'rt guruhi: (1) **easy / hard / difficult** — «...ish oson / qiyin» va gapni «aylantirish»; (2) **nice of you to** — kishining xatti-harakatiga baho; (3) **glad / sorry / surprised to** — his-tuyg'uning sababi; (4) **the first / the last / the only to** va **sure / bound / likely to** — tartib va taxmin. O'zbekchada bularning har biri boshqacha ifodalanadi, shuning uchun so'zma-so'z tarjima ko'pincha xato beradi.
It's hard to understand him = He's hard to understand

**It's difficult to understand** him = He**'s difficult to understand**. Ikkinchi gapda ega — kishi yoki narsaning o'zi, va gap oxirida olmosh **takrorlanmaydi**: «He is difficult to understand **him**» — xato. Bu qolip shu sifatlar bilan ishlaydi: easy, hard, difficult, impossible, dangerous, safe, expensive, cheap, interesting, nice, comfortable. Sifat va ot birga ham kelishi mumkin: It's **a difficult question to answer**; Tashkent is **an easy city to get around**. Fe'l predlog bilan bo'lsa, predlog oxirida qoladi: This river is dangerous **to swim in**.

rows: It's easy to find the hotel.
It's hard to please my boss.
It's dangerous to swim in this river.
This river **is dangerous to swim in**.
It's **a dangerous river to swim in**.

items.text: This new phone **is** really **easy to use**, even for my grandmother.
items.translation: Bu yangi telefonni **ishlatish** hatto buvim uchun ham juda **oson**.

items.text: Some English words **are impossible to translate** into Uzbek.
items.translation: Ba'zi inglizcha so'zlarni o'zbekchaga **tarjima qilib bo'lmaydi**.

items.text: It was **a hard decision to make**, but I think it was right.
items.translation: Bu **qabul qilish qiyin bo'lgan** qaror edi, lekin menimcha, to'g'ri bo'ldi.

blocks.text: It's nice of you to ... — kishiga baho

Kishining xatti-harakatiga baho berganda: **It's nice / kind / generous / clever / sensible / silly / stupid / careless / rude / unfair of somebody to do** something. Bu yerda predlog — **of** (for emas): It was **kind of you to help** — Yordam berdingiz, **juda mehribonsiz**. Taqqoslang: It's **hard for me to** get up early — bu yerda «kim uchun qiyin» (for), baho emas. Bahoni kishiga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri ham aytish mumkin: You were **silly to believe** him; yoki qisqa: That was **careless of** me.

rows: It was **kind of** Aziz **to lend** me his car.
It's **difficult for** Aziz **to drive** at night.
It's **silly of** you **to worry** so much.

items.text: It's very **kind of** you **to invite** us to your daughter's wedding.
items.translation: Qizingizning to'yiga **taklif qilganingiz uchun rahmat**, juda **mehribonsiz**.

items.text: It was **careless of** Tom **to leave** the door unlocked.
You were **brave to tell** the manager what really happened.
items.translation: Menejerga aslida nima bo'lganini **aytib, jasorat qilding**.

blocks.text: His-tuyg'u + to: glad to hear, sorry to see

His-tuyg'u bildiruvchi sifatlardan keyin **to + fe'l** shu tuyg'uning **sababini** bildiradi: **glad / pleased / happy / relieved / sorry / surprised / amazed / disappointed / shocked + to hear / see / learn / find out**. I was **surprised to see** Jasur at the party — Ziyofatda Jasurni **ko'rib hayron qoldim**. O'zbekchada odatda «-ib» yoki «-ganimdan»: **eshitib** xursand bo'ldim, **ko'rganimdan** xafa bo'ldim. «I'm glad for hearing» — xato. **sorry to** va **sorry for** farqi — keyingi darsda (→ 66-dars).

items.text: We were **relieved to hear** that everyone was safe after the earthquake.
items.translation: Zilziladan keyin hamma omon ekanini **eshitib, yengil tortdik**.

items.text: Kate was **disappointed to find out** that the concert had been cancelled.
items.translation: Konsert bekor qilinganini **bilib**, Keytning **hafsalasi pir bo'ldi**.

items.text: I'm **pleased to tell** you that you've got the job.

blocks.text: the first to ..., sure to ..., likely to ...

**the first / second / last / next / only (one) + to do** — «...gan birinchi / oxirgi / yagona kishi»: Madina was **the first to arrive** — Madina **birinchi bo'lib** keldi. Bu aniqlovchi ergash gapning qisqa shakli: the first person **who arrived** = the first **to arrive**. Ikkinchi guruh — gapiruvchining taxmini: **sure / certain / bound + to do** — «albatta, shubhasiz»: Aziz **is sure to win** — Aziz albatta yutadi (men aminman); **likely to** — «ehtimol»; **unlikely to** — «dargumon». Diqqat: **He's sure to win** — **men** aminman; **He's sure that he'll win** — **u o'zi** amin. Bu farq haqida → 66-dars.

items.text: Who was **the last to leave** the office last night?
Don't worry about the exam — you**'re sure to pass**.
Food prices **are likely to rise** again next year.
items.translation: Kelasi yil oziq-ovqat narxlari yana **oshishi ehtimoli bor**.

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: (1) olmosh takrorlanadi: «This book is easy to read **it**» → This book is easy **to read**. (2) of o'rniga for: «It's kind **for** you to help» → kind **of** you. (3) «It's difficult **to me**» → difficult **for** me. (4) his-tuyg'udan keyin -ing: «I'm glad for hearing the news» → I'm glad **to hear** the news. (5) «He was the first **who to** come» → the first **to come** (yoki the first **who came**).

Qisqa formula: kishiga baho — **of** (kind of you); kim uchun qiyin / oson — **for** (hard for me); tuyg'uning sababi — **to** (glad to hear); «birinchi / yagona bo'lib» — **the first / the only to**; taxmin — **sure / bound / likely to**.

rows: He was **the only one to help**.

examples.title: **It's easy / hard / difficult to** ...
examples.description: It + sifat + to + fe'l: biror ishni qilish oson, qiyin, xavfli yoki qimmat ekanini aytish. Kim uchun — for me / for her.

sentences.text: It's **difficult to find** a cheap flat near the university.
sentences.translation: Universitet yaqinidan arzon kvartira **topish qiyin**.

sentences.text: Is it **safe to drink** the tap water in Samarkand?
sentences.translation: Samarqandda vodoprovod suvini **ichish xavfsizmi**?

sentences.text: It was **hard for** Madina **to say** goodbye to her classmates.
sentences.translation: Madinaga sinfdoshlari bilan **xayrlashish og'ir bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: Nowadays it's **cheaper to book** flights online than through a travel agent.
sentences.translation: Hozir aviachiptalarni sayyohlik agentligidan ko'ra onlayn **band qilish arzonroq**.

sentences.text: When your computer crashes before a deadline, it isn't **easy to stay** calm.
sentences.translation: Muddat oldidan kompyuteringiz ishdan chiqqanda **xotirjam qolish oson emas**.

sentences.text: Would it be **possible to change** my appointment to Thursday?
sentences.translation: Qabulimni payshanbaga **ko'chirish mumkinmi**?

sentences.text: For beginners, it's **dangerous to climb** without a guide.
sentences.translation: Yangi boshlovchilar uchun yo'lboshlovchisiz tog'ga **chiqish xavfli**.

sentences.text: Was it **difficult to get** a visa for the UK?
sentences.translation: Buyuk Britaniyaga viza **olish qiyin bo'ldimi**?

sentences.text: It's **interesting to compare** how people celebrate New Year in different countries.
sentences.translation: Turli mamlakatlarda Yangi yil qanday nishonlanishini **taqqoslash qiziq**.

sentences.text: Without a car, it's **impossible to get** to the village in winter.
sentences.translation: Mashinasiz qishda qishloqqa **yetib borishning iloji yo'q**.

examples.title: Turned round: he **is hard to understand**
examples.description: Ega — kishi yoki narsaning o'zi: He is hard to understand (It's hard to understand him o'rniga). Oxirida olmosh takrorlanmaydi.

sentences.text: Our new neighbour **is very easy to talk to**.
sentences.translation: Yangi qo'shnimiz bilan **gaplashish juda oson**.

sentences.text: The instructions **were impossible to follow** without pictures.
sentences.translation: Rasmlarsiz ko'rsatmalarga **amal qilib bo'lmasdi**.

sentences.text: Jasur's handwriting **is so hard to read** that even he can't understand it.
sentences.translation: Jasurning yozuvini **o'qish shunchalik qiyinki**, hatto o'zi ham tushunmaydi.

sentences.text: **Is** the museum **easy to find**, or should I take a taxi?
sentences.translation: Muzeyni **topish osonmi** yoki taksiga o'tirganim ma'qulmi?

sentences.text: These shoes **are comfortable to wear** but **difficult to clean**.
sentences.translation: Bu poyabzalni **kiyish qulay**, lekin **tozalash qiyin**.

sentences.text: My boss **is** very **hard to please** — nothing is ever good enough.
sentences.translation: Boshlig'imni **rozi qilish juda qiyin** — unga hech narsa yoqmaydi.

sentences.text: Some mushrooms **are dangerous to eat**, so don't pick them yourself.
sentences.translation: Ba'zi qo'ziqorinlarni **yeyish xavfli**, shuning uchun ularni o'zingiz termang.

sentences.text: **Was** the exam **difficult to pass**? — Not really, but it was long.
sentences.translation: Imtihondan **o'tish qiyin bo'ldimi**? — Unchalik emas, lekin uzoq davom etdi.

sentences.text: Oliver's Scottish accent **is quite difficult to understand** on the phone.
sentences.translation: Oliverning shotlandcha talaffuzini telefonda **tushunish ancha qiyin**.

sentences.text: This wardrobe **is too heavy to carry** up the stairs on your own.
sentences.translation: Bu shkafni zinadan yolg'iz **ko'tarib chiqib bo'lmaydi** — juda og'ir.

examples.title: Adjective + noun + **to**: a hard question to answer
examples.description: Sifat + ot + to + fe'l: It's a difficult question to answer. Ba'zan oxirida predlog qoladi (a cheap hotel to stay in).

sentences.text: That's **a difficult question to answer** in just two minutes.
sentences.translation: Bu ikki daqiqada **javob berish qiyin bo'lgan** savol.

sentences.text: Bukhara is **a wonderful city to explore** on foot.
sentences.translation: Buxoro — piyoda **aylanib chiqish uchun ajoyib** shahar.

sentences.text: Winter is **the worst time to travel** to the mountains by car.
sentences.translation: Qish — tog'ga mashinada **borish uchun eng noqulay** vaqt.

sentences.text: Is Manchester **a good place to live** if you have small children?
sentences.translation: Kichik bolalaringiz bo'lsa, Manchester **yashash uchun yaxshi joymi**?

sentences.text: He isn't **an easy person to work with**, but he's very talented.
sentences.translation: U bilan **ishlash oson emas**, lekin u juda iqtidorli.

sentences.text: Kate lent me **a really gripping novel to read** on holiday.
sentences.translation: Keyt menga ta'tilda **o'qish uchun** juda qiziqarli roman berib turdi.

sentences.text: Green tea is **a healthy drink to have** after a heavy meal.
sentences.translation: Ko'k choy — og'ir ovqatdan keyin **ichish uchun foydali** ichimlik.

sentences.text: That was **a stupid thing to say** in front of your boss.
sentences.translation: Boshlig'ing oldida bunday gapni **aytish ahmoqlik** edi.

sentences.text: We need **a cheaper hotel to stay in** during the conference.
sentences.translation: Konferensiya davomida **to'xtash uchun** arzonroq mehmonxona kerak.

sentences.text: Football is **an exciting game to watch**, but I prefer playing it.
sentences.translation: Futbolni **tomosha qilish maroqli**, lekin men uni o'ynashni afzal ko'raman.

examples.title: **It's kind of you to** ...: judging behaviour
examples.description: Kishining xatti-harakatiga baho: kind / nice / silly / careless / generous of somebody to ...; You were brave to ... ham mumkin.

sentences.text: It's so **kind of** you **to offer** me a lift to the airport.
sentences.translation: Meni aeroportga **olib borishni taklif qilyapsiz** — **juda mehribonsiz**.

sentences.text: It was **silly of** me **to leave** my umbrella at home on such a cloudy day.
sentences.translation: Shunday bulutli kunda soyabonimni uyda **qoldirib, ahmoqlik qildim**.

sentences.text: How **generous of** your uncle **to pay** for the whole trip!
sentences.translation: Amakingiz butun safar xarajatini **to'labdi — qanday saxiylik**!

sentences.text: Wasn't it **rude of** Tom **to leave** without saying goodbye?
sentences.translation: Tomning xayrlashmasdan **ketib qolgani qo'pollik** emasmi?

sentences.text: You were **brave to report** the problem to the director.
sentences.translation: Muammo haqida direktorga **xabar berib, jasorat qildingiz**.

sentences.text: It was **careless of** the builders **to leave** the gate open all night.
sentences.translation: Quruvchilar darvozani tun bo'yi ochiq **qoldirib, beparvolik qilishgan**.

sentences.text: That was **really nice of** Dilnoza **to bring** us homemade samsa.
sentences.translation: Dilnozaning bizga uy somsasini **olib kelgani juda yoqimli** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: I think it's **unfair of** the school **to punish** all the pupils for one boy's mistake.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, bitta bolaning xatosi uchun maktabning hamma o'quvchilarni **jazolashi adolatdan emas**.

sentences.text: Thank you for the flowers — it was very **thoughtful of** you.
sentences.translation: Gullar uchun rahmat — **juda e'tiborli** ekansiz.

sentences.text: Was it **sensible of** Bekzod **to quit** his job before finding a new one?
sentences.translation: Bekzod yangi ish topmasdan oldin **ishdan ketib, to'g'ri qildimi**?

examples.title: Feelings: **glad to hear**, **surprised to see**
examples.description: His-tuyg'u + to + fe'l — tuyg'uning sababi: glad / relieved / surprised / disappointed / sorry to hear, see, learn, find out.

sentences.text: I'm **glad to hear** that your father is feeling better.
sentences.translation: Otangizning ahvoli yaxshilanganini **eshitib xursand bo'ldim**.

sentences.text: We were **surprised to see** snow in Tashkent in April.
sentences.translation: Aprel oyida Toshkentda qorni **ko'rib hayron qoldik**.

sentences.text: Sarah was **relieved to learn** that her flight hadn't been cancelled.
sentences.translation: Reysi bekor qilinmaganini **bilib**, Sara **yengil tortdi**.

sentences.text: Fans were **disappointed to hear** that the band had cancelled the tour.
sentences.translation: Guruh gastrolni bekor qilganini **eshitib**, muxlislarning **hafsalasi pir bo'ldi**.

sentences.text: I was **sorry to hear** that the old cinema in our street is closing.
sentences.translation: Ko'chamizdagi eski kinoteatr yopilayotganini **eshitib achindim**.

sentences.text: Aziz was **amazed to discover** how cheap the flights to London were.
sentences.translation: Londonga aviachiptalar qanchalik arzonligini **bilib**, Aziz **hayratda qoldi**.

sentences.text: **Were** you **shocked to find out** the truth about your neighbour?
sentences.translation: Qo'shningiz haqidagi haqiqatni **bilib, larzaga tushdingizmi**?

sentences.text: Our team is **proud to announce** the opening of a new office in Bukhara.
sentences.translation: Jamoamiz Buxoroda yangi ofis ochilganini **e'lon qilishdan faxrlanadi**.

sentences.text: Grandma will be **delighted to see** all her grandchildren together at Navruz.
sentences.translation: Buvim Navro'zda barcha nevaralarini bir joyda **ko'rib, behad xursand bo'ladi**.

sentences.text: Nobody was **pleased to hear** that the meeting would last three hours.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilish uch soat davom etishini **eshitib**, hech kim **xursand bo'lmadi**.

examples.title: **the first / the last / the only one to** ...
examples.description: the first / second / last / next / only (one) + to + fe'l — «birinchi / oxirgi / yagona bo'lib ...gan».

sentences.text: Madina was **the first to arrive** at the party, as usual.
sentences.translation: Odatdagidek, ziyofatga Madina **birinchi bo'lib keldi**.

sentences.text: Who was **the last person to see** the documents before they disappeared?
sentences.translation: Hujjatlar yo'qolishidan oldin ularni **oxirgi marta kim ko'rgan**?

sentences.text: Neil Armstrong was **the first man to walk** on the Moon.
sentences.translation: Nil Armstrong Oyda **qadam qo'ygan birinchi odam** edi.

sentences.text: Oliver was **the only one to notice** the mistake in the contract.
sentences.translation: Shartnomadagi xatoni **payqagan yagona odam** Oliver edi.

sentences.text: Who will be **the next to speak** at the conference?
sentences.translation: Konferensiyada **keyingi bo'lib** kim **so'zga chiqadi**?

sentences.text: Our school was **the first in the region to install** solar panels.
sentences.translation: Maktabimiz viloyatda quyosh panellarini **o'rnatgan birinchi** maktab bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Emma is always **the last to leave** the office in the evening.
sentences.translation: Emma kechqurun ofisdan doim **eng oxirida chiqadi**.

sentences.text: Bekzod became **the youngest player ever to score** for the national team.
sentences.translation: Bekzod terma jamoa uchun gol **urgan eng yosh futbolchi** bo'ldi.

sentences.text: If you ever need help, I'll be **the first to come**.
sentences.translation: Agar qachondir yordam kerak bo'lsa, **birinchi bo'lib men kelaman**.

sentences.text: Kate was **the second woman in her family to go** to university.
sentences.translation: Keyt oilasida universitetga **kirgan ikkinchi ayol** edi.

examples.title: **sure to**, **bound to**, **likely to**
examples.description: Gapiruvchining taxmini: sure / certain / bound to (albatta, shubhasiz), likely / unlikely to (ehtimol / dargumon).

sentences.text: Take an umbrella — it**'s bound to rain** this afternoon.
sentences.translation: Soyabon ol — tushdan keyin **albatta yomg'ir yog'adi**.

sentences.text: Aziz has trained for months, so he**'s sure to do** well in the marathon.
sentences.translation: Aziz oylab mashq qildi, shuning uchun marafonda **albatta yaxshi natija ko'rsatadi**.

sentences.text: The new metro line **is likely to open** next spring.
sentences.translation: Yangi metro liniyasi **ehtimol** kelasi bahorda **ochiladi**.

sentences.text: Petrol prices **are unlikely to fall** in the near future.
sentences.translation: Yaqin orada benzin narxi **tushishi dargumon**.

sentences.text: If you leave your bike unlocked, someone **is certain to steal** it.
sentences.translation: Velosipedni qulflamay qoldirsangiz, kimdir uni **albatta o'g'irlab ketadi**.

sentences.text: **Is** the train **likely to be** late because of the snow?
sentences.translation: Qor tufayli poyezd **kechikishi mumkinmi**?

sentences.text: There **are bound to be** problems with any new software.
sentences.translation: Har qanday yangi dasturda muammolar **bo'lishi muqarrar**.

sentences.text: Don't tell Jasur about the party — he**'s sure to tell** everyone.
sentences.translation: Jasurga ziyofat haqida aytma — u **albatta** hammaga **aytib qo'yadi**.

sentences.text: Young drivers **are more likely to have** accidents than older ones.
sentences.translation: Yosh haydovchilarning keksalarga qaraganda **avariyaga uchrash ehtimoli ko'proq**.

sentences.text: With such a talented cast, the film **is sure to be** a big success.
sentences.translation: Shunday iqtidorli aktyorlar bilan film **albatta** katta muvaffaqiyat **qozonadi**.

examples.title: Dialogue: Nilufar's first day at work
examples.description: Suhbat: yangi xodim birinchi ish kunida hamkasbi bilan gaplashadi — darsdagi barcha qoliplar bir joyda.

sentences.text: — Welcome to the team, Nilufar! We're **pleased to have** you here.
sentences.translation: — Jamoaga xush kelibsiz, Nilufar! Sizni bu yerda **ko'rib turganimizdan xursandmiz**.

sentences.text: — Thank you, it's very **kind of** you **to show** me around.
sentences.translation: — Rahmat, menga hamma joyni **ko'rsatib chiqyapsiz, juda mehribonsiz**.

sentences.text: — My pleasure. Is the office **easy to find** from where you live?
sentences.translation: — Arzimaydi. Ofisni uyingizdan kelib **topish osonmi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, but the car park **is impossible to get** into after nine.
sentences.translation: — Ha, lekin to'qqizdan keyin avtoturargohga **kirishning iloji yo'q**.

sentences.text: — Then try to be **the first to arrive** — that's what I do.
sentences.translation: — Unda **birinchi bo'lib kelishga** harakat qiling — men shunday qilaman.

sentences.text: — Good idea. And what about the manager? Is he **hard to work** for?
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr. Menejer-chi? U bilan **ishlash qiyinmi**?

sentences.text: — Not at all, but he**'s bound to ask** you lots of questions at first.
sentences.translation: — Umuman yo'q, lekin avvaliga sizga **albatta** ko'p savol **beradi**.

sentences.text: — I'm **glad to hear** that. I was a bit nervous this morning.
sentences.translation: — Buni **eshitib xursand bo'ldim**. Ertalab biroz hayajonlangan edim.

sentences.text: — Everyone is. On my first day, I was **silly to worry** so much, too.
sentences.translation: — Hamma shunday. Men ham birinchi kunim shuncha **xavotirlanib, ahmoqlik qilgandim**.

sentences.text: — Well, you're **the only person to make** me feel relaxed so far!
sentences.translation: — Xullas, hozircha meni xotirjam **qilgan yagona odam** sizsiz!
